Hope you’re well. Attached is the proposed 12-month retainer SOW and updated cost breakdown for the marketplace listing & deployment support HA bundle (see attachments: nimbus_retainer_SOW_v3.pdf; cost_breakdown_2027.xlsx).

Summary of changes from last year:
- Flat annual retainer increased 6% to cover extended 24/7 onboarding support.
- One-time deployment fee of $18,000 (was $15,000) tied to prioritized listing placement and accelerated integration.
- Optional managed listing promotion credit available for an additional 6% of monthly spend.

Next steps we request:
1) Confirmation of the SOW scope and PO number by 11/27.
2) If OK, we’ll issue a DocuSign for signature; otherwise send redline commentary and we’ll turn around an updated draft within 48 hours.

Thanks — we’d like to keep the current launch cadence for Q1 region expansion, so a quick turnaround helps.

Best,

Quick model thoughts (summary):
- If deployment fee stays at $18k, amortized across expected new listing-driven ARR (~$720k ARR over 12 months), incremental cost is ~2.5% of that ARR — tolerable if placement uplift is >=6%.
- If we push fee to $10k + 6 months placement credit valued at $8k, net economics similar but gives us operational leverage.

Recommend negotiating these concessions before signing:
1) 50/50 deployment payment schedule.
2) Written placement-performance credit (3 months) tied to metric: >10% month-over-month listing growth for first 3 months.
3) Add a clause capping scope creep charges for network integration (e.g., any additional integration beyond 5 hours to be pre-approved).

I’ll prepare a clean redline of the SOW and outline the PO language for procurement.

Marcus Lin
Sr. Pricing & GTM Ops
